Technical SEO.title: Google Search Console Crawl Stats Missing A Day Of Data: September 15th
Technical SEO.summary: The Google Search Console crawl stats report is missing data for September 15th, continuing a recurring pattern. Google has historically restored missing data in similar past incidents.

Technical SEO.title: Google Web Guide Classic Search Button Doesn't Take You To Classic Search
Technical SEO.summary: A bug has been identified in Google's beta Web Guide feature, where clicking the Classic Search button fails to exit the Web Guide interface and return users to standard search results. Web Guide is described as a hybrid of the AI search results interface and the traditional web search interface.

AI Search / GEO.title: LLM Citation Study: 13,184 Citations Across 4 AI Tools | Orbit Media Studios
AI Search / GEO.summary: Orbit Media Studios published a data study examining citation behavior across four AI tools, analyzing a dataset of over 13,000 citations to identify which sources and domains are referenced most by LLMs.

AI Search / GEO.title: Mastering generative engine optimization in 2026: Full guide
AI Search / GEO.summary: Search Engine Land has published a comprehensive guide to generative engine optimization, covering strategies for achieving visibility in AI-driven search surfaces in 2026.

AI Search / GEO.title: Position: Generative Engine Optimization Creates Underexamined Risks, Governance Must Target Concentration, Disclosure, and Academic Blind Spots
AI Search / GEO.summary: An academic paper argues that GEO introduces underexamined risks including concentration of visibility, lack of disclosure, and blind spots in academic research, calling for governance frameworks to address these issues.

AI Search / GEO.title: IF-GEO: Conflict-Aware Instruction Fusion for Multi-Query Generative Engine Optimization
AI Search / GEO.summary: This arxiv paper introduces a conflict-aware instruction fusion approach for optimizing content visibility across multiple simultaneous queries in generative AI search engines.

AI Search / GEO.title: How to Earn LLM Citations: A Practical Guide for AI-Search Visibility in 2026
AI Search / GEO.summary: SEOProfy has published a practical guide focused on earning citations from large language models, targeting practitioners seeking to improve brand and content visibility within AI search answers.

AI Search / GEO.title: Top Cited Domains Across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini & Google AI | LLM Pulse
AI Search / GEO.summary: LLM Pulse has published a data study identifying the domains most frequently cited across four major AI platforms: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI, providing a benchmark for AI search visibility.
